For Pokemon’s 25th anniversary, McDonald’s Happy Meals included mini-boosters of 4 random cards, with one being in confetti holofoil. This promotion started in February 2021 in the United States, and rolled out across the world, with Spain’s October 2021 promotion being the last one.
